text:
Elliot Price: Heads up — as part of the streaming/tool calling refresh, we’re renaming a couple docs pages. Need to lock redirects + deprecation language today so we don’t ship broken links. Dropping proposed mapping below, please react/flag.

Elliot Price: Proposed (old -> new):
- /guides/streaming -> /guides/streaming-responses
- /guides/tool-calling -> /guides/tools
- /guides/json-mode -> /guides/structured-output
- /api-reference/chat/completions -> /api-reference/responses (keeping old for now w/ banner)

Elliot Price: Also: we have old anchors referenced all over (README links, blog posts). Need a checklist for broken links + search indexing.

Wei Chen: +1 on the guides. For API ref: I’m nervous about hard redirecting /chat/completions since SDKs still say “chat completions” in some places. I’d prefer keep page live and add “Deprecated — see Responses” callout + cross-links.

Kira Thompson: Agree. Redirect guides are fine; API ref should be “soft” deprecation. We should be explicit about what’s deprecated: page URL? endpoint? semantics? We’re not deprecating the endpoint this sprint, just the docs page name.

Henry Cho: Yep, product stance: do NOT imply endpoint is deprecated. Wording should be “Docs renamed” and “Recommended interface” rather than “Deprecated endpoint”.

Elliot Price: Got it. So:
- Guides: 301 redirect
- API refs: keep /chat/completions page, add top banner “This page is being superseded by Responses; semantics are equivalent for supported fields; see compatibility notes.” No 301 yet.

Ibrahim Khan: Quick nuance: we have OpenAI-compat docs that reference /guides/tool-calling specifically. If we redirect to /guides/tools, cool, but make sure the new page keeps the same #anchors or we’ll break deep links.

Renee Sullivan: +1 anchors. A ton of community links go straight to sections like “…/guides/tool-calling#parallel-tool-calls” and “…#partial-arguments”. If anchor IDs change we’ll get support pings.

Wei Chen: Can we preserve anchor IDs by keeping the same headings? Or add explicit anchor tags? In Docusaurus we can add custom `id` on headings.

Elliot Price: Yes — we can force heading ids. Let’s add explicit ids for the “known pitfalls” sections too.

Kira Thompson: Proposed “must preserve” anchors (from old page):
- #tool-definitions
- #arguments
- #parallel-tool-calls
- #tool-results
- #known-pitfalls
- #partial-arguments
- #retries-and-idempotency

Kira Thompson: Also on streaming page:
- #event-types
- #assembling-the-final-message
- #handling-disconnects

Ibrahim Khan: Add: #structured-output (if present on tools page) should remain stable. But if it moves to dedicated structured-output guide, just make sure old anchor redirects there.

Elliot Price: OK. Redirect plan update:

1) 301 redirects (netlify/_redirects):
- /guides/streaming  /guides/streaming-responses  301
- /guides/tool-calling  /guides/tools  301
- /guides/json-mode  /guides/structured-output  301

2) Anchor compatibility:
- Keep heading ids on new pages matching old ones where possible.
- If a section moved, add an inline “see …” link + consider manual anchor mapping (Docusaurus doesn’t do anchor-level redirects cleanly, but we can keep a stub section with the old id).

3) Soft deprecation:
- Keep /api-reference/chat/completions (no redirect)
- Add top banner + link to /api-reference/responses

Wei Chen: Works. On the banner text, can we avoid the word “deprecated” entirely? Maybe:
“Note: This page has been renamed. For new integrations, use the Responses API docs.”

Henry Cho: +1. “Renamed/superseded” is fine. Avoid “deprecated” for now.

Renee Sullivan: Search indexing: if we 301 guides, Google should follow, but Algolia/DocSearch might keep old results for a bit. Do we need to manually remove old records?

Elliot Price: We should do both:
- ensure sitemap has only new URLs
- run a DocSearch reindex after deploy
- confirm old pages return 301 and no longer show up in internal search

Kira Thompson: Broken links checklist (suggested):
- Run `yarn build` (Docusaurus) w/ broken link checks enabled
- Run link checker against prod preview (we have `scripts/check-links.ts`)
- Grep repo for old URLs (/guides/tool-calling, /guides/json-mode, /guides/streaming)
- Check top external inbound links (we can pull from GSC / top pages)
- Validate code tab UX on new pages (we had that selector bug last month)

Wei Chen: + add: check versioned docs. Some old URLs may still exist under /v1/… depending on how we publish versions.

Elliot Price: Good call. We’re publishing unversioned for these guides, but the API ref is versioned. Action item: confirm redirects also apply under /v1/ if users are pinned.

Ibrahim Khan: Also SDK READMEs: python/ts/go might link directly to old guides. I’ll ping Monica/Sabrina but we should have redirects regardless.

Elliot Price: I’ll own redirects + stub sections + banner language. Wei can you own search reindex + confirm sitemap output? Kira can you capture this in the migration notes page?

Wei Chen: Yep. I’ll add to release checklist: “trigger reindex after merge to main + verify search results for ‘tool calling’, ‘json mode’, ‘streaming’.”

Kira Thompson: Yep I’ll update docs-refresh-migration-notes with:
- list of renames
- redirect rules
- “do not call endpoint deprecated” language guidance

Docs Deploy Bot: Preview build ready: https://docs-preview.redwood.example/pr/534 (expires in 7 days)

Renee Sullivan: In preview, /guides/tool-calling currently 404 (expected until redirects land). When you add redirects, also sanity check that copy/paste links in the “Known pitfalls” section don’t use relative anchors that changed.

Elliot Price: Noted. I’ll add a manual smoke test list:
- Open old URLs in incognito, confirm 301 to new
- Test deep links:
  - /guides/tool-calling#parallel-tool-calls
  - /guides/streaming#assembling-the-final-message
  - /guides/json-mode#validation
- Confirm internal search returns new page
- Confirm no broken links reported in build

Henry Cho: Looks good. Once banner text is final, tag me for quick review.

Elliot Price: Will do. Thanks all — I’ll push redirect PR today and drop link here for final +1s.
